'''KT-310'''<ref name="DI3.0">''[[Disney Infinity 3.0]]''</ref> was a red-plated, cylindrical [[KT power droid]]<ref name="Kids" /> that lived on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Jakku]]. Around thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]], it was present in the [[junk dealer]] [[Unkar Plutt]]'s shop in [[Niima Outpost]] on Jakku shortly on the [[First Order]]'s [[Attack on Tuanul|attack]] on the nearby [[Tuanul]] village. While the droid stood behind the booth Plutt worked in the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] brought him several pieces of scrap worth one quarter portion of [[foodstuff]]. The droid moved away before the next in line, the pet trader [[Bobbajo]], moved up to the booth. The next [[Standard day|day]], KT-310 was still in Niima and witnessed Rey knock down the [[First Order]] deserter [[Finn]] with her [[quarterstaff]] inside one of the outpost's structures. The First Order then [[Escape from Jakku|attacked]] Niima shortly after.<ref name="TFA" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:KT-310_disney.png|thumb|left|100px|KT-310 in Disney Infinity 3.0]]
KT-310 first appeared as a minor background character in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], but was not identified.<ref name="TFA" /> It was then named by the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Disney Infinity 3.0]]'', which was released in conjunction with the film in [[2015]].<ref name="DI3.0" /> Despite the game being non-[[canon]], story group member [[Pablo Hidalgo]] confirmed on [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] that the names provided by the game for previously unidentified characters, including KT-310, were considered canon.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/749616406245699584|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2016-07-03|quote=@LelalMekha Yeah, same with Infinity.|archivefile=File:PabloHidalgo-LegoName-Twitter.png|nolive=1}} {{C|In response to: "@pablohidalgo <nowiki>youtube.com/watch?v=JwxAeHPLpPg</nowiki> The Lego game identifies a few BG characters from TFA, but are those names canonical?"}}</ref> In the game, KT-310 is awarded to players who complete the mission "Bolt of Inspiration" with a three star rating.<ref name="DI3.0" />
